svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Online Exams & Submissions Platform - revised cost-optimized architecture (ap-southeast-1 Singapore, two AZs)
Blue = request path. Grey dashed = async / supporting. Red hexagon Sn = single point of failure (see legend). Green Cn = change against Assignment 2. Struck-through grey = removed.
Edge (global) - served from CloudFront edges in India
AWS Region ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) - regional services below are multi-AZ by design, no subnets
PC 50 x 1 h + Aurora min 4 ACU
Aurora daily 35 d · all monthly 5 y
VPC 10.20.0.0/16 - data tier only (no IGW, no NAT, no route out)
Aurora cluster storage - 6 copies across 3 AZs · PITR 35 days · Data API endpoint (HTTPS, no DB connections)
Lambda functions call Aurora through the Data API and every other service through its regional endpoint,
so nothing zonal sits in the request path: losing an AZ costs at most one Aurora failover (S1).
REMOVED: reader in AZ-b promoted automatically (F1)
REMOVED: 6 copies / 3 AZs + PITR 35 d + monthly 5 y
REMOVED: Lambdas out of the VPC, no NAT at all
ACCEPTED: rollback in 20 s (F4), no deploys in exam windows
Single KMS key and DB secret
ACCEPTED: regional multi-AZ service, 30-day deletion window
ACCEPTED: regional multi-AZ; 4-h tokens outlast an exam
ACCEPTED: SQS keeps emails 4 days, DLQ + alarm
ACCEPTED: not in requirements; backups allow rebuild
ACCEPTED: outside AWS; answers kept in browser storage
Aurora 2 x db.r6g.large -> Serverless v2, reader tier 2
us-east-1 -> ap-southeast-1; WAF/ACM pinned to us-east-1
Lambdas out of VPC; NAT gateways + 4 subnets removed
Provisioned concurrency 300 x exam day -> 50 x 1 h
Exam definition cached 60 s per Lambda instance
DynamoDB daily backups dropped (PITR covers 35 d)
